rename.from: How to take `--release-notes` in CI env
rename.to: How to push `--release-notes` in CI env

body:
I think this is a bug in our script, actually. 

It whould pass the received args to the binary.
Good, I will try to fix it on my project and then will send you PR.
thanks, its probably just append a `$*` here: https://github.com/goreleaser/get/blob/master/get#L28
I think so, `$@` or `$*` should pass.

Hm, not so simple, [circleio gave me that](https://circleci.com/gh/nem-toolchain/nem-toolchain/464):

```
#!/bin/bash -eo pipefail
if [[ -n ${CIRCLE_TAG} ]]; then
  curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nem-toolchain/nem-toolchain/master/scripts/goreleaser | bash -s -- --release-notes \
    <(git log --pretty=oneline --abbrev-commit $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)^.. | grep '^[^ ]* \[')
fi
bash: line 28: /tmp/tmp.E4lgdhQtYH/goreleaser --release-notes /dev/fd/63: No such file or directory
Exited with code 1
```

Probably process substitution mechanism doesn't work between shells, in our case between original an a spawn one.
I will try again, but with temporary file instead of process substitution...
`No such file or directory` was because of `"${TMPDIR}/goreleaser $@"`, when I changed it to `"${TMPDIR}/goreleaser" "$@"` it starts to work, also with process substitutions.
I will try just to send to `goreleaser` a simple string in order to test it, is it ok, nor MD, but simple text?

So, I changed it to

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/39793/31153141-bf854382-a89f-11e7-97c4-9423d313ab74.png)

but result the same:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/39793/31153152-cae5c4a4-a89f-11e7-951d-1d7a25afd338.png)

What am I doing wrong?

hmm, this seems like a bug...

lemme check
